edbDesc: Occurs when light in a medium (such as air, water or a crystal) interacts with time dependent optical density variations and changes its energy (frequency) and path.
title: Brillouin Scattering
pickWhy: Light bouncing off sound waves in a material is the same interaction as the acousto-optic effect, from the same 1922 Brillouin prediction; merged into that card (kept in this batch).
